sentences.en: There are many pretty clothes in the shop.
Mom really likes that pretty piece of clothing.
She says, "How much is this piece of clothing?"
Mom bought that pretty piece of clothing, and she is very happy.

quiz.q: What does the shop have a lot of?
How much does the clothing cost?
How does mom feel after buying the clothes?

grammar.e: 多少 asks about an amount; put it before 钱 to ask the price of something.
grammar.x: 这个衣服多少钱？ — How much is this piece of clothing?

grammar.p: 这个 / 那个 — this / that (+ measure word 个)
grammar.e: 这 and 那 combine with the measure word 个 to point at a specific thing.
grammar.x: 妈妈很喜欢那个漂亮的衣服。 — Mom really likes that pretty piece of clothing.

grammar.e: 了 goes right after the verb to show the action already happened.
grammar.x: 妈妈买了那个漂亮的衣服。 — Mom bought that pretty piece of clothing.
